independent_assessment.defensible_root_cause_class: producer publication did not reach selector-consumable ARMED state, or selector observed it as not ARMED; static bytes do not support a missed hook, wrong call target, wrong r9 direct gate, metadata overlap, or reset-signature mismatch as the primary explanation
independent_assessment.most_likely_live_mechanism: fewer than all sixteen exact direct products were accepted by the producer after slot0 reset, leaving state LOADING (1) rather than ARMED (2); host-side successful bulk sends alone do not prove firmware-side producer acceptance/count advancement
independent_assessment.why_all_stock_matters: selected path would assign r1 to 0x01c46520 + (note-36)*0xa0; stock on every Ch10 pad is compatible with state != 2 or selected valid != 1 before that assignment

observed_live_failure_from_user: after exact installed reset-aware S1-C3 functional candidate and successful 16 packet send, all Ch10 pads sound stock Ch1

producer_publication_contract_checked_st.direct_entry: 0x0201e224 reset wrapper via call bytes bfeadcfe
producer_publication_contract_checked_st.metadata_overlap: slot0 voice uses 0x01c46520..0x01c465bb; slot0 valid/lock/count/state are 0x01c465bc..bf; slot1 starts at 0x01c465c0, so metadata is in the four padding bytes not copied by the 0x9c voice memcpy
producer_publication_contract_checked_st.publication: valid clear, memcpy 0x9c, csync, valid=1, loaded_count=i+1, and only slot15 stores state=2 ARMED
producer_publication_contract_checked_st.r9_gate: 0x0201e1a6..0x0201e1ac copies r9, subtracts 0xa3, and returns before lock/testset/stores unless exact direct length is present
producer_publication_contract_checked_st.reset_signature: 0x0201e228..0x0201e230 checks accepted staging bytes [0..1] == 62 63, then clears lock/count/state at 0x01c465bd..bf before calling 0x0201e1a2

selector_fallback_contract_checked_stati.fallback_effect: r1 remains the original stock/H2 fallback source unless both state and valid pass, so every Ch10 pad sounding stock is exactly the selector fallback symptom
selector_fallback_contract_checked_stati.valid_gate: 0x0201e174 loads selected slot valid; 0x0201e176 requires valid == 1

single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.intended_future_live_protocol: with explicit future authorization, install diagnostic, send only exact slot00 note36 packet once, then press the physical pad that emits Ch10 note36; do not send the remaining 15 packets for this checkpoint
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.interpretation_if_note36_changes_from_st: producer ingress, reset signature, r9 gate, staging pointer, memcpy, slot0 valid publication, and selector hook/source selection are live; current failure is completion/final publication to ARMED, such as dropped/rejected later packets or count progression
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.interpretation_if_note36_remains_stock: failure is before or at slot0 publication/selector reach, such as producer not invoked, r9 gate not passing, staging signature mismatch in live route, lock/testset issue, or hook/channel gate not reaching selected path
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.name: S1C3-PUB1 state-gate discriminator
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.one_code_discriminator: temporarily change only the selector state comparison immediate at 0x0201e164 from state == 2 to state == 1; keep the selected-slot valid gate unchanged
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.static_byte_target: selector branch bytes at 0x0201e164 are 80f80a04 for jne r0,#2,copy; discriminator changes the encoded immediate from 02 to 01 only after independent encoding validation
single_discriminator_minimal_checkpoint.why_minimal: one selector predicate discriminates LOADING-with-valid0 from no-publication while preserving the producer and valid byte ABI
